analysis.title: Tactical Equity Trading Alert: Consider Buying Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (FCX US)
key_insights: Bank J. Safra Sarasin's FSA Equity Competence Center initiates a 120-day TETA trade idea to buy Freeport-McMoRan (FCX US) with a take-profit level of US$80 and a stop loss of US$52.
FCX has pulled back from its year-to-date high of US$80 in July as US Treasury yields rose and commodity miners sold off broadly. The last price is US$66.0.

Copper has stayed resilient through the sell-off, with LME pricing above $14,000/MT. The author attributes the gap between FCX and copper mainly to liquidity pressure, since FCX is well owned by hedge funds that may have cut equity exposure in 3Q.

The author sees a cleaner setup because the COMEX-LME copper premium has vanished on reduced expectations of US copper tariffs, and the Grasberg mine disruption is behind the company with production resuming.
Copper is expected to stay in an uptrend on demand from AI and data center consumption. The author treats the FCX decline as a pullback within a longer-term uptrend.
Easing of the US dollar or interest rates could be the catalyst for FCX to converge with copper prices. The author expects the selloff to be a short-term phenomenon.

Valuation shown: P/E (next year) 15.5, EV/EBITDA (next year) 6.3, EV/Sales (next year) 3.1, P/BV 4.5, indicated dividend yield 0.9%, market cap about $94.7B. The note lists a Buy rating, a PRC Risk Rating of Level 5 High and an ESG rating of B.

The note's TETA track record table lists the closed ideas' returns against benchmarks. Recent entries still open include Murata, Oracle and Credo, and the 2026 closes include Snowflake (+57.0%) and Microsoft (+21.7%).

market_movers.rationale: A 120-day tactical long on a pullback from the US$80 July high. Copper holds above $14,000/MT, the COMEX-LME premium has vanished, and Grasberg production is resuming. Stop loss is US$52.

sector_views.rationale: Copper demand from AI and data center consumption supports an uptrend, and the commodity miner sell-off is seen as short term.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Copper has held up while miner equities sold off, which the author reads as a disconnect that FCX can close.
